comment: Pretty chill professor, definitely values participation heavily. He wants his students to learn and actually take away information rather than just a grade. A few group projects that aren't insanely difficult, but only a few grades throughout the semester and you won't know how you stand til the very end.

This professor was an amazing teacher and super fun and engaging. He is pretty lenient on grading as well and believes more in students actually learning rather than just assessments. He allows your creativity to show and gives fun and informative assignments. I would love to take another class with him again someday!

Dr. Alcalde is an absolute gem. He is hilarious and makes learning fun. The class isn't too difficult, and he is accessible outside of class. My favorite quote from him is "One day I wish to be able to teach a music theory class all based on memes" and his humor is evident in each and every class.

His into to music class isn't the easiest, it's actually music theory. However, he is one of the best personalities at UR. He is funny, chill, and an all around good time. The classroom is always a relaxing and fun environment.

Dr. Alcalde is a funny and chill professor. Music theory can be dry and confusing, but he finds ways to connect it to popular music which makes class interesting. He plays a song before every class then ties it into the lecture.
